description: We are a group of Star Hunters going on a space exploration mission.
summary: Our game(Last Chance Mission) is a fun, interactive, and educational game. It simulates your boss giving you one last chance to succeed your mission. You'll need to precisely calculate how much fuel and food you'll need to pack up under a tight bugdet. For example, if you're traveling to the moon, you will need to have at least 1.6*10=16 m/s^2 fuel and 10*1=10 food along with a heater and a cooler. details: Our website can help in real life astronomy by showing how much fuel, food, and equipment to bring on missions to different planets. We used html, css, and js to code our game. Our project is definitely one of the most creative projects you will ever see because most of it is hand-drawn. To draw all the images and icons, we used Procreate and IbisPaintX.
